description: Search the 1-Wire buses again for thermometers - after wiring a new sensor, or when one is missing from myio_read_sensors. Needs firmware 4.27+ (GIGA: the main buses; Opta: the AUX bus of the Ext16 expanders). The controller pauses for about 0.1 s per sensor while it searches. The reply lists the thermometers afterwards and marks the new and the missing ones. A new sensor gets the next free id and an empty name (name it with myio_rename kind=thermo); to learn which one it is, use myio_wait_sensor. Stored settings are not changed. Editor level.
name: myio_sensor_rescan
title: Rescan the 1-Wire buses
